Single Ingredients

Bone Meal

Espoma Organic Bone Meal is an all-natural organic source of nitrogen, phosphorus, & calcium that helps develop sturdy root systems and promotes plant growth.  Bone Meal breaks down slowly providing a long-lasting reservoir of these essential plant nutrients. Like all Espoma Organic plant foods, no sludges or fillers are ever used. And because it’s made in our state-of-the-art solar powered manufacturing facility, consistency and quality are guaranteed.

 

  • Promotes Growth & Flowering
  • 100% Natural & Organic
  • Long Lasting Slow-Release Feeding
  • For Planting Spring & Fall Bulbs
  • Safe for People, Pets & Planet
View Specs & Safety Data

Available in 4, 10 and 24 lb. bags.

1 lb. equals 2 ¼ cups

Directions

For use on...

Bulbs, gardens, trees, shrubs, flowers and roses

Buttercup
Crocus
Daffodils
Dutch Iris
Fritillaria
Grape Hyacinth
Hyacinth
Tulips
Scilla
Snowdrops
Spanish Bluebells
Spider Lily
Starflower

 

Spring Planted Bulbs

Anemone
Begonias
Caladium
Calla Lilies
Canna Lilies
Crocosmia
Dahlias
Elephant Ears
Freesia
Gladiolus
Lilies
Nerine Lily
Rain Lily
Ranunculus

 

When to use

  • Apply at time of planting
  • For existing plants use spring & fall

How much to use

  • Bulbs and Gardens:
    Apply at a rate of 10 pounds per 100 sq. ft., raking it well into the soil. For individual bulbs, mix 1 teaspoon of Bone Meal into the soil.
  • Shrubs and Trees:
    Apply 1 or 2 pounds depending upon size of shrub or tree. Rake well into soil under entire spread of shrub or tree.
  • Potted Plants:
    Apply 2 oz or one heaping tablespoon per pot and work into the soil. Water thoroughly after applying.
